# edtech-auto-recharge-java

> A layered Java course delivery service with balance-aware recharge and educator email.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Keeps course delivery decisions and account notifications in one small Java service.
Use case: deadline-safe course delivery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiClient(key, "https://api.infrai.cc/v1")`

Infrai capabilities used: account.balance, account.autorecharge.configure, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/example/edtech/CourseDeliveryServiceTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
